A '''swoop gang''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caprioril]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was briefly part of the group, working as a [[come-up flector]] under the alias "Marellis".<ref name="FC">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref>
